# Pavia

> Pavia is a modern, elegant womenswear boutique based in Beirut, Lebanon. Soft
> tailoring, ruffles and quiet neutrals, cut to be easy to wear. Delivered
> anywhere in Lebanon, ordered over WhatsApp at +961 3 017 725.

Tagline: elegance, made effortless.

Pavia sells online at pavialeb.com. The catalog is loaded live from a database
after the page opens, so a crawler that does not run JavaScript will not see
individual products. This file is the shop stated in plain text instead.

## Contact and ordering

- WhatsApp (fastest, and how most orders are placed): https://wa.me/9613017725
- Phone: +961 3 017 725 (local format 03 017 725)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/pavia.leb
- Website: https://pavialeb.com/

Orders are placed on the site or over WhatsApp, then confirmed by a person on
WhatsApp or by phone before anything ships.

## What Pavia sells

Womenswear only. The collection runs to dresses, tops and blouses, soft
tailoring (blazers, waistcoats, trousers) and matching two-piece sets. The
register is modern and elegant rather than streetwear or occasion-wear: quiet
neutrals, ruffles, drape, and shapes that are unstiff enough to wear all day.

## Delivery and payment

- Delivery: anywhere in Lebanon. Flat delivery fee of $3.
- Payment: cash on delivery, or Whish Money.
- Prices are in US dollars.

## Questions people actually ask

**What is Pavia?**
An online womenswear boutique based in Beirut, Lebanon, selling modern elegant
clothing with delivery across the country.

**Does Pavia deliver outside Beirut?**
Yes. Pavia delivers anywhere in Lebanon, for a flat $3 delivery fee.

**How do I order from Pavia?**
Add pieces to the bag on pavialeb.com and check out, or message +961 3 017 725
on WhatsApp. Either way a person confirms the order with you before it ships.

**How do I pay?**
Cash on delivery when the order arrives, or Whish Money.

**Does Pavia have a physical shop?**
Pavia is based in Beirut and sells online, with delivery across Lebanon.
Contact the shop on WhatsApp for anything you want to see in person.

**What sizes does Pavia carry?**
Sizes vary by piece and are listed on each product on the site, with a size
filter on the collection page. Ask on WhatsApp if you are between sizes.

**Is Pavia the same as the city of Pavia in Italy?**
No. This Pavia is a Lebanese fashion label and online boutique in Beirut.
